name: Castform Sunny Form

attacks.name: Sunny Scorching
attacks.text: If a Stadium is in play, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned.

flavor:
Castform changes to this form when it basks in
bright sunlight. When you touch its glowing skin,
it feels all dried out!
